title: stelis juxta
intro: Stelis juxta, commonly known as the "False Ant Orchid", is a type of flowering plant species in the orchid family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Stelis juxta include its use in reducing pain and inflammation, as well as its ability to aid in the healing of wounds. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which have been studied for their potential antimicrobial and antioxidant properties.
